info.title: A.R.M.O.R. MQTT topics
info.description: Who publishes and who reads each topic of the broker, with the QoS, whether the broker keeps it, the schema of its messages and the access lines of each role. Generated: do not edit.

broker.description: the broker of the installation (Mosquitto on the CM5)

node_telemetry.description: What a radar node sees: the tracks and the light.

node_presence.description: The presence of a radar or a wall panel (not the health report, which is armor/health/{node_id}).

node_info.description: Name, firmware and address of a radar node or a wall panel.

node_command.description: A command to a radar node. Never retained and sent at most once: an old command must never be delivered later.

node_health.description: The health report of a node of any family.

radar_events.description: The events of the perimeter engine of a radar node.

radar_armed.description: Reserved: the access list of a radar node allows reading it and no message is defined yet.

solar_state.description: An inverter or a battery read by a solar gateway; the `kind` of the message says which.

device.description: the device the message is about

solar_battery_command.description: A maintenance step on a battery (write capability); never retained.

solar_battery_result.description: The answer to a maintenance step.

electrical_state.description: The measurements and the switches of an electrical node.

electrical_command.description: A command to one switch; never retained.

electrical_result.description: The answer to a switch command.

alarm_state.description: What the panel of an alarm node is doing.

alarm_command.description: Arm, disarm or silence; never retained.

alarm_result.description: The answer to an alarm command.

alarm_zone_feed.description: What the server says about a Zigbee zone while it holds the radio; may be signed.

alarm_policy.description: What the server asks of the panel (configuration hash, zone feed, signature).

control_command.description: An order to one node (restart, pause, standby, identify, diagnostics...); never retained.

control_command_all.description: An order to every node; an arm only, never an execute.

control_maintenance.description: A node that is about to be quiet on purpose says so; kept by the broker so that a server that starts later also reads it.

network_state.description: What a network node sees of the local network.

server_alert.description: The alert of the server for whoever listens (a siren, a screen).

device_layer.description: The device layer: `{relay}/state`, `availability` and `set` of each device of a node. Free-form values, described by the device registry of the server.

x-lifecycle.about: The birth message of a node and its last will are sent on this topic at QoS 1 and kept by the broker, so a server that starts later learns that a node is gone.
